group.name: Edge Intelligence for Autonomous Systems Lab
address: College of Computing and Data Science
description: We build spatial edge intelligence for robots that have to perceive, map, and navigate in real time, while remaining robust and computationally lightweight.

Our lab is part of [EI Research Group](https://siewkeilam.github.io/ei-research-group), and we are located at the College of Computing and Data Science ([CCDS](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/computing)), NTU, Singapore.
